units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:25">Num. R. s. 16</cite> <he>מפני שלא היה לו י׳ להספיק וכ׳</he> (not <he>להוסיף</he>) because he had no power to sustain him, <he>אין לשון י׳ אלא מזונות</he> the word <he>י׳</he> refers to sustenance (ref. to <he>מכלת</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 5:25">I Kings V, 25</cite>, cmp. <cite ref="K00755"><he>כִּלְכֵּל</he></cite>).
